title: Project Manager
desc:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
Analog Devices Inc. is seeking a motivated and dynamic Project Manager to join our RF Semiconductors (RFS) team. RFS combines ADI’s RF technology groups to create an industry leading team which brings-to-market high performance integrated ASSPs and building block RF ICs, which complete ADI’s signal chains from Antenna to Baseband in ASD, INS and COMs applications. As an engineering project manager within the RFS team you will be responsible for managing the development of new products, advanced core technology and intellectual property (IP) to meet the requirements of our broad customer base. You will work closely with engineers leading various functional aspects of product development projects, planning and coordinating overall development activities. You will be part of a large organization, collaborating with engineers at several locations globally.
Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible!
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Planning & Execution
Lead large scale initiatives affecting multiple teams and regions making decisions with long term implications for functions or BU.
Collaborate with Engineering Directors, Product Designers, Engineers, Applications, Marketing, and Manufacturing to define and align project goals with market demands and business objectives.
Project Leadership
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, and staffing to ensure successful delivery of milestones.
Proactively identify and mitigate obstacles and risks, ensuring project continuity and quality.
Be able to work and lead projects independently.
Design and implement new processes and solutions.
Cross-Functional Coordination
Partner with other Program Managers to prioritize deliverables across concurrent development and sustaining projects.
Facilitate effective communication and alignment across global teams to optimize performance and resolve conflicts.
Stakeholder Engagement
Serve as the primary point of contact for internal communications, providing regular updates, escalating critical issues, and ensuring transparency across all levels.
Ensure compliance with internal standards, customer requirements, and industry regulations throughout the project lifecycle.
Mentor others and actively upskills team members.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, or related field.
10+ years of experience managing complex technical projects in a high-tech or semiconductor environment.
Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and delivering results in a matrixed organization.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in RF or IC product development cycle from concept to production.
Strong proficiency in project management tools such as MS Project, Confluence, Jira, and Excel (including VBA).
PMP or equivalent certification is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, drive strategic initiatives, and influence stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to coach and mentor junior level Project Managers
For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.
